isi.note: One of Japan's largest language schools. Many Nepali students enrolled. Strong university admission support.

akamonkai.name: Akamonkai Japanese Language School
akamonkai.note: Excellent track record for university and graduate school admission. Located near the University of Tokyo in Bunkyo.

sendagaya.name: Sendagaya Japanese Language School
sendagaya.note: Academic and career development support. Conveniently located in Shibuya.

nepal-and-japan.name: Nepal & Japan

visa.title: Visa & Residency Status Info
visa.disclaimer: This app does not act as a visa agent. Information is for reference only. Please confirm the latest details directly with each organization.

specified-skilled.name: Specified Skilled Worker (特定技能)
specified-skilled.note: Visa for working in 14 industries including agriculture, manufacturing, and construction. Type 1 and Type 2 available. Requires passing an exam or completing Technical Intern Training Level 3.

student-visa.name: Student Visa (留学)
student-visa.note: Visa for attending Japanese language schools, vocational schools, or universities. Apply after receiving school admission. Part-time work up to 28 hours/week permitted.

engineer-visa.name: Engineer / Humanities / International
engineer-visa.note: Visa for specialized work in IT, interpretation, trade, etc. Requires a university degree or relevant work experience.

immigration-agency.name: Immigration Services Agency of Japan
immigration-agency.note: The official body for visa applications, residency status changes, and renewals. Regional offices nationwide. Check the official site for application forms.

tokyo-immigration.name: Tokyo Immigration Bureau
tokyo-immigration.note: Handles applications for Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba, and Saitama. 7 min walk from Shinagawa Station. Advance appointment recommended. Tel: 0570-034259.

nepal-embassy.name: Embassy of Nepal in Japan
nepal-embassy.note: Passport renewal and certificate issuance. Located in Shinagawa, Tokyo. Book consular services via the official website.

gyoseishoshi.name: Administrative Scrivener (Visa Support)
gyoseishoshi.note: Licensed professionals who prepare visa application documents. Available for complex cases and status change procedures.

wagaya-japan.note: Japan's largest foreigner-focused real estate portal. Supports 13 languages including Nepali. Many no-guarantor properties. 24/7 support available.

bridge-life.name: Bridge Life Co., Ltd.
bridge-life.note: Foreign resident specialist real estate agency. Nepali among 8 supported languages. Founded 2008 with 10,000+ cases handled. Support from move-in to move-out.

gtn.name: GTN (Global Trust Networks)
gtn.note: Rent guarantee company specializing in foreign residents. Nepali language support. Helps foreigners pass rental screening. 200,000+ cases per year.

best-estate.name: Best-Estate.jp
best-estate.note: Property search site for foreigners with English UI. Many no-guarantor and foreigner-welcome listings across Japan.

leopalace21.name: Leo Palace 21
leopalace21.note: Furnished apartments available for short-term stays. Many foreigner-friendly properties nationwide.
